title: [master]- Posting service order without External document no. will copy the 'Service Order No.' to GL entries
summary: Posting a service order without an External Document No. no longer copies the Service Order No. into the G/L entries. The fix is in Serv-Documents Mgt. in the W1, NA, ES and IT layers.
key_points: Fixes the Service Order No. being copied into G/L entries when no External Document No. is set
Serv-Documents Mgt. (codeunit 5988) changed in the W1, NA, ES and IT layers
Service posting invoice tests added in W1 and NA
